purpose: The site footer for a website: brand, optional tagline, a row of footer links and the copyright line.
namedChanges: Words come from props, not from `useAppConfig` (brand), `data/site` (tagline, nav) or `useI18n` (link words); the unit imports none of those.
The links are a `<ul>` of `<li>`, not the bare links the gilb-web file drew.
Each link is at least 44 px tall (the myjackfruit footer's tap-target rule); the gilb-web links were the height of the text only.

`endLink` is the right-hand link from the variant source KaiGilb/mynet-web `components/site/SiteFooter.vue` at ca601b9f188343e5075057907678dad64324269e ("Built on Gilb" there); here it is a prop, left out unless the host passes it.
The `brand` slot is new; both source files wrote the brand name in a paragraph and had no slot.
Styles are written out without Tailwind, `@apply` or `theme()`, on the `--site-block-*` CSS variables.
Top and bottom padding are gilb-web's (3.5rem, 1.5rem); mynet-web's 3rem and 1.25rem are not used.

host.replaces: mynet-web's hard-coded gilbOrigin "Built on Gilb" link
